instagram:
Customer bus mein hai. Aapki website phone par kholi. Page khula hi nahi. 😬

Aaj zyada tar log website computer par nahi, phone par kholte hain. Desktop par sab theek dikhta hai, isliye owner ko pata hi nahi chalta ki mobile par kya toota hai.

Ek furniture shop ki homepage par camera se seedhi photos thi. Phone par page khulne mein bahut der lagti thi. Photos sahi size mein compress ki, aur wahi page jhat se khulne laga. Design wahi raha, bas wazan kam hua.

Mobile par toot rahi website ki 3 nishaniyan:
❌ Page ko side mein scroll karna padta hai
❌ Padhne ke liye zoom karna padta hai
❌ Buttons itne paas hain ki ek dabao to doosra dab jaye

Fix:
✅ Website mobile data par kholkar dekhiye, wifi par nahi
✅ Photos sahi size mein lagaiye
✅ Faltu sliders aur popups hataiye
✅ Call aur WhatsApp button wahan rakhiye jahan angootha pahunche

Aapne aakhri baar apni website phone par kab kholi thi? Comment mein batao 👇

🌐 webeventuals.com
